note: Gin Everywhere extends the Gin admin theme's content-form layout to every content entity. It has NO configuration: the module is two hooks on the autowired service Drupal\gin_everywhere\Hook\GinEverywhereHooks. hook_gin_content_form_routes_alter (ginContentFormRoutesAlter) appends, for every content-group entity type, routes like entity.<type>.edit_form/.add_form/.create_form/.revision/.content_translation_add plus <type>.add, and fixed extras (block_content.add_page/add_form, entity.block_content.canonical, entity.media.canonical, entity.menu.add_link_form, entity.menu_link_content.canonical). hook_form_alter builds Gin's advanced/meta groups only when the active theme is gin. Requires the Gin theme (hook_requirements). Because there is no config, medium cases inspect the running site by invoking the service and reading the routes it adds; hard cases toggle the module (reset uninstalls -> verify FAILS; agent re-enables -> verify PASSES; cleanup restores the enabled baseline).

evals.prompt: What does the Gin Everywhere Drupal module do, and through which Gin hook does it achieve it? Which theme must be present for it to work?
evals.expected_output: It extends Gin's node-style content-form layout (sticky action bar + advanced meta sidebar) to every content entity's forms, by implementing hook_gin_content_form_routes_alter() to add those entities' form routes (plus a form_alter that builds the meta/advanced groups). It requires the Gin admin theme.

evals.prompt: How do I configure Gin Everywhere after installing it? Where are its settings?
evals.expected_output: There is nothing to configure. Gin Everywhere has no settings form or configuration; simply enabling the module (with the Gin theme present) is the entire setup.

evals.prompt: Besides node forms, name some of the entity forms Gin Everywhere brings Gin's layout to, and mention how it decides which routes to cover.
evals.expected_output: It covers create/edit/revision/translation forms for every content-group entity type (media, taxonomy terms, users, block content, custom entities) plus extras like entity.media.canonical and menu link forms. It derives the routes dynamically from all entity types whose group is 'content'.

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, determine (from Gin Everywhere's actual behaviour, not documentation guesses) whether it applies Gin's content-form layout to the media canonical page route. State the exact route name it adds for that.
evals.expected_output: Yes. Invoking the GinEverywhereHooks service's ginContentFormRoutesAlter() shows entity.media.canonical among the routes it adds.

evals.prompt: On this live site, which edit-form route does Gin Everywhere add for the taxonomy_term entity so that Gin's layout is applied to editing a term? Verify it against the module's running behaviour.
evals.expected_output: entity.taxonomy_term.edit_form. Because taxonomy_term is a content-group entity type, ginContentFormRoutesAlter() adds entity.taxonomy_term.edit_form (and .add_form, .revision, etc.).

evals.prompt: On this site, ensure Gin's content-form layout is applied to media (and every other content entity) by enabling the Gin Everywhere module. After enabling it, its route-alter should add entity.media.canonical to Gin's covered routes. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The gin_everywhere module is enabled, and GinEverywhereHooks::ginContentFormRoutesAlter() returns a route list containing entity.media.canonical.

evals.prompt: Custom block (block content) add forms on this site should use Gin's form layout. Make that happen using the Gin Everywhere module and apply it to the live site. Once enabled, Gin Everywhere adds block_content.add_form to Gin's covered content-form routes.
evals.expected_output: The gin_everywhere module is enabled, and GinEverywhereHooks::ginContentFormRoutesAlter() returns a route list containing block_content.add_form.
